messages.content:
Propose one executable offline metadata feature for the PUBLIC request. Return feature5.2 JSON only. Every plan explicitly chooses result_use: value / unavailable / unavailable_or_zero. Preserve source, requested filters, output rows and population. Do not replace an unsupported analysis with an easier calculation. You choose purpose, narrow meaning, calculation expression and result_use. For a calculation-result availability request, expression computes the requested value/comparison and result_use=unavailable checks that result. Do not enumerate missing causes with nullable OR. For unavailable-or-known-zero of a numeric result, select result_use=unavailable_or_zero. Result views are typed common compiler operations; they are not hidden fixes. Describe the selected final output, with no invented empty-case values; code infers types/units/missing policies/IDs/SHA. Never guess operational meaning from raw codes or unknown units. Physical parent existence is not a mandatory-parent business contract. A valid calculation may be constant or have no selected observations. If source, relation or an exact supported expression is unavailable, return candidates=[] with a precise complete stop_reason.
Supported expression nodes: column(op,table,column), literal(op,value), is_missing(args1), subtract/divide/eq/lt/lte/gt/gte/and/or(args2), not(args1), in/not_in(args1,values homogeneous1..32 literals), if(args3), datetime_diff(args2,unit=ms/s/us), convert_unit(args1,from_unit,to_unit), child_count/parent_match_count(relationship_id), conditional_count(relationship_id,where), child_sum(relationship_id,value,where), group_count(keys,where). No add/abs or parent attribute lookup. Use JSON null, not string null.
Relations are child/from -> parent/to. child_count, conditional_count, child_sum output PARENT rows; parent_match_count outputs CHILD rows. All nonliteral operands share output rows, including if's condition and branches. Grain keys identify output rows, not all source columns. group_by lists only actual group_count keys. A known empty child aggregate is0, missing relationship/key/predicate propagates unavailable. Division by0 is unavailable, never numeric0. is_missing tests any nested result and returns complete true/false on retained rows. and/or strictly propagate any unavailable operand; true OR unavailable is unavailable. if validates both branches, then lazily evaluates only the selected branch; unavailable condition stays unavailable. Filter-excluded or unknown-selection rows produce no output, not false or unavailable values. Do not hide invalid sources, types or execution errors as missingness.
The calculation component and final inspected output are distinct: never wrap the expression in a missingness test merely because result_use already requests unavailable. A public calculation_type constrains the inner value/comparison, not the final view. Keep one concise complete meaning sentence about the final view; detailed branch/empty-group behavior is recorded by compiler facts. Write purpose and meaning in English; quote original literal tokens when needed, but do not switch languages in explanatory prose. needed_evidence must not list unrelated supplied unit IDs. Write short COMPLETE purpose<=200, meaning<=320, stop_reason<=320. Prefer one concise meaning sentence around150–220 characters; do not repeat the whole plan or append a long branch-by-branch narrative. Explain calculation, filters, output row and result states. True0 differs from no evaluable rows. Raw IN/OUT/MAP/VOID/UNKNOWN have no business meaning beyond supplied authority. No fault/normality/SLA/online claim follows from offline metadata.
